## Timing assessment

- mir_eval and Thumbnailator: A2/document-repair/fresh-B2 paths are already complete. A1 has no dependable finish time under repeated provider failures.
- tslearn: retain a conditional planning allowance of roughly 4–14 hours AFTER its A2 provider failures clear for source recovery, document repair and fresh B2. This is a sensitivity window, not a confidence interval; it assumes normal provider responses and variable 1–3 average document rounds, excludes new provider outages, source retries deferred behind A1, independent semantic review and S_B2. Existing successes do not guarantee that remaining APIs will finish similarly.
- Example: A2 completion by Tuesday 3 PM could place that tslearn path roughly Tuesday 7 PM to Wednesday 5 AM. A2 has not met this condition.
- S_B2: not started. The global priority gate waits for tslearn B2 and Thumbnailator source retries. Thumbnailator source retries currently wait for its unfinished A1 control. There is no defensible absolute finish estimate for S_B2 under this gate.
- Full study: at the observed rate of resolving provider outcomes, completion by Wednesday 11 AM is unlikely without relief of the provider/scheduling bottlenecks. No finite upper bound is supported by unlimited retries.
- The existing report observer is configured to freeze available evidence at or after Wednesday 10:45 AM. The deadline package may therefore be partial; missing cells and provider failures remain explicit.

Thumbnailator assertion-enabled replay is complete for A2 (114/149 accepted) and B2 (126/149 accepted). These remain separate from native outcomes (127/149 and 139/149) and are not independent semantic certification.

This update changes no protocol, queue, worker, checkpoint or measurement. MDAnalysis, Sedona and RDPro reruns remain deferred.
